summary: The relay's connection drops: the new connection waits for the ready frame, subscribes both topics again, and the OI held from the old session is gone on the desktop until the first new OI packet.

notes: The web's client keeps its OI cache across a reconnect: only an unsubscribe drops an entry (iiflcapital_websocket.py:282, 467).

deviations.reason: The web passes IIFL's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
The web sends the packet's best bid and ask with their quantities in Quote and Depth frames; the desktop decodes them (MarketPacket::best_bid_price and the rest) and its common carrier drops them.

deviations.reason: After a reconnect the desktop has forgotten the OI (the new session's OI has not come yet) and sends 0, an invented value (BKD-09); the web merges the OI held from the session before the drop, a stale value from another session (a web defect too: its OI cache survives the reconnect, iiflcapital_websocket.py:282, 467). The right frame leaves OI out until the new session's OI packet.
